cases.sentence: Если человек согрешит, промолчав, когда его приведут к ___.
cases.translation: If anyone sins by remaining silent when brought to swear an oath.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to) can take prepositional case when referring to bringing someone to take an oath.

cases.sentence: Если человек произносит опрометчивую клятву, сделать что-либо хорошее или злое, о чем только можно безрассудно поклясться, то даже если он не осознает этого, когда поймет, он ___.
cases.translation: If anyone swears rashly with his lips, and it is hidden from him, when he knows of it, then he will be guilty.
cases.explain: After the verb 'будет' (will be), the predicate adjective takes nominative case.

cases.sentence: Если кто-то виновен в этом, пусть открыто признает, в чем согрешил, и в расплату за свой грех приведет Господу для жертвы за грех самку ___.
cases.translation: If anyone is guilty, they shall confess their sin and bring a female lamb as a sin offering.
cases.explain: The transitive verb приведет (bring) takes the accusative case for its direct object.

cases.sentence: Если ему непосредством принести овцу, пусть принесет Господу двух горлец или двух молодых голубей как расплату за свой ___.
cases.translation: If he cannot afford a lamb, he shall bring two turtledoves or two young pigeons as payment for his sin.
cases.explain: After the preposition за (for), accusative is used when referring to the sin being atoned for.

cases.sentence: Пусть он отдаст их ___, который сначала принесет жертву за грех.
cases.translation: He shall give them to the priest, who shall first offer the sin offering.
cases.explain: The verb отдаст (give to) takes the dative case for the indirect object.

cases.sentence: Остаток ___ принадлежит священнику, как в случае с хлебным приношением.
cases.translation: The remainder of the offering belongs to the priest, as with the meal offering.
cases.explain: The possessive construction 'remainder of the offering' uses the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Если человек совершит проступок, согрешив по неведению против какой-либо из Господних святынь, он должен привести Господу в расплату ___.
cases.translation: If anyone commits a trespass by sinning unwittingly concerning Yahweh's holy things, he must bring a ram as restitution.
cases.explain: The transitive verb привести (bring) takes the accusative case for the direct object.

cases.sentence: Это жертва повинности. Он провинился перед ___ и должен возместить нарушение.
cases.translation: It is a trespass offering. The person has sinned against the Lord and must make restitution.
cases.explain: The preposition перед (before) takes the instrumental case for indicating guilt before someone.

reading.ru: Если человек согрешит, промолчав, когда его приведут к присяге, чтобы свидетельствовать о том, что он видел или знал, он подлежит наказанию.
reading.question: What type of sin was committed if a person remained silent when brought to swear an oath as a witness?
options: They sinned by lying under oath
They sinned by touching something unclean
They sinned by remaining silent when required to testify
They sinned by making a false promise
reading.correct: They sinned by remaining silent when required to testify
reading.explain: The text states that remaining silent when brought to testify by oath constitutes a sin.

reading.ru: Или если человек прикоснется к нечистому, к трупам нечистых диких зверей, или нечистого скота, или нечистых присмыкающихся, даже если не заметит этого, он станет нечистым и будет виновен.
reading.question: What makes a person unclean according to this verse?
options: Touching unclean animals or carcasses, even unknowingly
Being near a holy place without permission
reading.correct: Touching unclean animals or carcasses, even unknowingly
reading.explain: The text lists touching various unclean things, including carcasses of unclean animals, as making a person unclean.

reading.ru: Если кто-то виновен в этом, пусть открыто признает, в чем согрешил, и в расплату за свой грех приведет Господу для жертвы за грех самку изотары, овцу или козу.
reading.question: What was required of someone who was guilty of these sins?
options: Public repentance and fasting for forty days
Confession of sin and bringing a female animal as an offering
Isolation from the community for seven days
Payment of money to the temple treasury
reading.correct: Confession of sin and bringing a female animal as an offering
reading.explain: The text explicitly states the guilty person must confess and bring a female animal for a sin offering.

reading.ru: Если ему непосредством принести овцу, пусть принесет Господу двух горлец или двух молодых голубей как расплату за свой грех.
reading.question: What was an alternative offering if someone could not afford a lamb?
options: A tenth of an ephah of fine flour
Two turtledoves or two young pigeons
reading.correct: Two turtledoves or two young pigeons
reading.explain: The verse provides alternatives for poorer individuals: two turtledoves or two young pigeons.

reading.ru: Он свернет птице голову, не отрывая ее до конца, и окропит кровью жертвы за грех в сторону жертвенника.
reading.question: How was the bird offering processed for the sin offering?
options: The bird was completely separated from its head and the blood was poured into a vessel
The bird's head was wrung off but not completely severed, and blood was sprinkled on the side of the altar
The bird was burned whole on the altar
The bird's feathers were removed and the meat was cooked
reading.correct: The bird's head was wrung off but not completely severed, and blood was sprinkled on the side of the altar
reading.explain: The text describes wringing the bird's head from its neck without severing it completely and sprinkling its blood on the altar.

reading.ru: Это жертва повинности. Он провинился перед Господом.
reading.question: What is significant about calling this a trespass offering?
options: It applies only to wealthy people
It is a guilt offering before the Lord for transgressing His holy things
It must be offered only on specific festivals
It requires the person to fast for a week
reading.correct: It is a guilt offering before the Lord for transgressing His holy things
reading.explain: The text identifies this as a trespass offering showing guilt before the Lord for sins committed.
